messaging_view_open_description: Threads that are open or waiting for the other side
messaging_view_overdue_description: Threads whose reply deadline has passed
messaging_view_review_description: Threads with document facts to review
messaging_offline_text: The inbox shows the last threads read. It updates when you’re back online.
messaging_live_interrupted_text: Luma checks for changes every 30 seconds until the connection returns.
messaging_mailbox_attention_text: Luma isn’t reading every mailbox right now: {mailboxes}.
messaging_placeholder_text: Open a thread to see its messages, linked records and replies. Use J and K to move through the list.
messaging_connect_text: Connect a shared operations mailbox, such as orders@ or purchasing@, through the Gmail app. Luma then reads only the messages your rules select.
messaging_empty_filtered_text: Change the search or mailbox filter to see more threads.
messaging_empty_text: Luma lists threads from messages that match your mailbox rules.
messaging_empty_mine: No open threads assigned to you
messaging_empty_unassigned: Every open thread has an owner
messaging_empty_all: Luma hasn’t read any threads yet
messaging_error_access: Your role no longer allows viewing message threads.
messaging_error_unavailable: The inbox is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
messaging_error_uncertain: Luma couldn’t confirm whether this was saved. Retrying sends the same request, so it’s applied at most once.
messaging_error_rejected: Luma couldn’t do this. Refresh and try again.
messaging_row_messages: {count, plural, one {{count, number} message} other {{count, number} messages}}
messaging_row_more_records: {count, plural, one {+{count, number} record} other {+{count, number} records}}
messaging_row_facts: {count, plural, one {{count, number} fact to review} other {{count, number} facts to review}}
messaging_row_attachments: {count, plural, one {{count, number} attachment} other {{count, number} attachments}}
messaging_rule_hint_sender_domain: Such as supplier.example. Subdomains match too.
messaging_rule_hint_sender_address: A full address, such as orders@supplier.example.
messaging_rule_hint_recipient_address: An address delivered to this mailbox, such as purchasing@yourshop.example.
messaging_rule_hint_label: A label or folder name in the mailbox.
messaging_document_text_pending: Luma will read this document shortly.
messaging_document_text_reading: Luma is reading this document. Facts appear when it’s done.
messaging_document_text_failed: Luma couldn’t read this document. You can read it again.
messaging_document_text_unsupported: Luma doesn’t read this file type. Open it in the mailbox.
messaging_document_text_unreadable: The file is damaged, encrypted or has no readable text.
messaging_document_text_duplicate: The same file arrived before. Review it on the original.
messaging_document_missing_text: It may have been removed, or it belongs to another workspace.
messaging_document_stale: This document couldn’t be refreshed. It shows the last version read.
messaging_document_no_content: The content isn’t available. It was removed after the retention period, or Luma hasn’t read it yet.
messaging_extraction_unavailable: Luma doesn’t propose facts for this document.
messaging_extraction_unavailable_reason: Luma doesn’t propose facts for this document: {reason}
messaging_extraction_manual: Select text or cells to add facts yourself.
messaging_facts_title: {count, plural, one {{count, number} fact} other {{count, number} facts}}
messaging_facts_empty: No facts yet. Select text or cells to add one.
messaging_facts_none_yet: Facts appear once Luma has read the document.
messaging_facts_removed_text: These facts were in the previous version and are missing here.
messaging_fact_add_hint: Select text in the document, or click cells (Shift-click for a range), to add a fact.
messaging_pick_text: {count, plural, one {{count, number} character selected} other {{count, number} characters selected}}
messaging_fact_match_ambiguous: Matches several records; choose one by correcting the fact:
messaging_fact_confirm_blocked: Low confidence or several matching records: correct this fact to confirm it.
messaging_fact_invalid: Check the fields: some values are missing or not in the expected format.
messaging_reply_text_draft: Review the text before sending. Nothing is sent until you send it or request approval.
messaging_reply_text_approval_required: Someone else must approve this reply before it can be sent.
messaging_reply_text_approved: Approved. The requester can send it now.
messaging_reply_text_rejected: The approver rejected this reply. It won’t be sent.
messaging_reply_text_expired: The approval expired before the reply was sent. Draft a new reply.
messaging_reply_text_sending: Luma is sending this reply and then reads the thread to confirm it arrived.
messaging_reply_text_uncertain: Luma can’t tell whether the mailbox sent this reply. Luma only checks by reading the thread and never sends it again.
messaging_reply_text_sent: A fresh read of the thread found this reply in the mailbox.
messaging_reply_text_failed: The mailbox didn’t send this reply.
messaging_reply_text_withheld: Luma stopped this reply before sending it.
messaging_reply_text_discarded: This reply was discarded and won’t be sent.
messaging_reply_reason_workspace_policy: the mailbox requires approval for every reply
messaging_reply_needs_approval: Needs approval from someone else because {reasons}.
messaging_reply_draft_hint: Luma drafts a reply from the current state of the linked records and cites each one. Missing or outdated information is stated, never filled in.
messaging_reply_no_permission: Your role doesn’t allow sending replies.
messaging_reply_earlier: {count, plural, one {{count, number} earlier reply} other {{count, number} earlier replies}}
messaging_reply_waiting_other: Waiting for someone else to approve your reply.
messaging_citations_none: No linked records were cited. Link a record to draft from its state.
messaging_citation_not_observed: Luma couldn’t read this record; the draft says so.
messaging_deadline_automatic_hint: Use the mailbox’s reply time after the latest unanswered message
messaging_deadline_invalid: Enter a valid date and time.
messaging_messages_title: {count, plural, one {{count, number} message} other {{count, number} messages}}
messaging_sender_unaligned_text: The mailbox checked this message and couldn’t confirm that it came from {domain}. The From address may be forged. Check with the sender before acting on it. Supplier facts from this message wait for review.
messaging_sender_unknown_text: The mailbox recorded no sender check for this message. This is common for imported mail. Luma treats the From address as unconfirmed, and supplier facts from this message wait for review.
messaging_text_truncated: This message is long; Luma kept the first part.
messaging_remove_text_text: Luma deletes the text and attachment content of this message. Sender, time, links and reviewed facts remain. This can’t be undone.
messaging_links_suggested_text: Luma found these records but didn’t link them. Confirm the right ones.
messaging_link_sender_unverified: Suggested because Luma couldn’t verify the sender’s address.
messaging_link_dialog_text: Linked records show this thread on their page and give replies their facts.
messaging_link_dialog_no_access: Your role can’t read records of type {kind}.
messaging_note_placeholder: Write a note for your team. It stays in Luma.
messaging_event_handed_off_generic: Recorded on the linked purchase order
messaging_event_delivery_confirmed_by_re: Delivery confirmed by the recipient’s reply
messaging_delivery_report: A delivery report says this email did not reach {recipient} ({status}). Luma couldn’t verify who sent the report, so it may be forged.
messaging_delivery_question: Ask the supplier whether the email arrived, then record the answer. Nothing is sent.
messaging_delivery_delivered_description: Only confirm after the supplier told you they received it. The email then counts as sent.
messaging_delivery_not_delivered_title: Mark this email as not delivered?
messaging_delivery_not_delivered_descrip: Only confirm after the supplier told you it didn’t arrive. The email then counts as failed, and the order email can be drafted and sent again.
messaging_delivery_note_hint: For example, who you spoke to. Internal only; never sent.
messaging_delivery_resolved_reply: Delivered: the supplier replied from an authenticated address
messaging_thread_missing_text: It may have been removed, or it belongs to another workspace.
messaging_thread_stale_text: It shows the last version read.
messaging_settings_description: Choose which messages Luma reads, how fast replies are due, and when replies need approval.
messaging_settings_backfill_hint: How far back Luma reads when a mailbox or rule is new.
messaging_settings_reply_hours_hint: Automatic deadline after an unanswered message.
messaging_settings_approve_all_hint: Otherwise only replies that confirm dates or quantities, or mention money, need approval.
messaging_settings_paused_hint: Luma stops reading new messages until you resume.
messaging_rules_privacy: Luma only reads messages that match a rule, and the messages your team sends to the same correspondents. Everything else in the mailbox stays unread by Luma.
messaging_rules_empty: No rules yet, so Luma reads nothing from this mailbox. Add a rule for a supplier domain or an alias.
messaging_rule_suppliers_no_access: Your role can’t read suppliers. Choose Other, or ask someone with procurement access.
messaging_rule_supplier_required: Choose the supplier these messages come from.
messaging_rule_reads_hint: After you add a rule, Luma reads matching messages from the read-back period.
messaging_record_empty: No message threads are linked to this record.
messaging_event_handed_off_forbidden: Not recorded on the purchase order: the mailbox’s reader can’t manage procurement
messaging_event_handed_off_empty: Not recorded on the purchase order: the message has no text
messaging_conditions_note: Filters use thread properties only, never message text.
messaging_event_handed_off_truncated: Not recorded on the purchase order: the message text is incomplete
